description: Mirabelle is developing a personal robot chef capable of chopping, cooking, and serving fresh meals on demand.
funding_summary: In December 2024, raised €1.3 million in seed funding. In April 2026, secured an additional €6 million in funding.

inflection_why_now: Advancements in vision AI have made it feasible to create machines with the precision and adaptability of a private chef.
devils_advocate_risks: Technical Complexity: Developing a robot capable of safely and efficiently preparing a wide variety of meals presents significant engineering challenges.
Market Adoption: Convincing consumers to integrate a robotic chef into their daily routines may face resistance due to cost, trust, and usability concerns.

SAP's expertise in enterprise software could assist Mirabelle in developing robust data analytics and management systems for their robotic kitchen solutions.
